<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

GLM-5.x (the `DeepseekV32` NVIDIA path) now leaves each decode MoE layer's top-k reduction open. The next RMSNorm's
fused all-reduce then finalizes it in one FlashInfer kernel (`trtllm_moe_finalize_allreduce_fusion`). This uses
the existing deferred-finalize contract (`MoEOutput`, `defer_moe_finalize`) that DeepSeek-V4.1 and Kimi-K3 already
use.

**Needs flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6630 (deadlock fix) and flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6631 (speed); draft until a
FlashInfer release with both is pinned.** Without the first the kernel can hang under back-to-back launches; without the
second, deferring is slower than the unfused path. flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6632 (cluster sizing) adds most of the gain
at 5-7 running requests.

## Claims

With the FlashInfer fixes, on GLM-5.2-NVFP4, TP4, MTP 3, B300:

- Target verify forward (`vllm bench forward`, spread < 0.1%): -1.2% to -1.3% at 1 request, -1.5% at 3, -0.8% at 7.
  Serving decode at batch 1: -1.2% ms/token.
- Per MoE layer, the GEMM2 tail is one kernel instead of three: finalize, shared + routed add, all-reduce +
  residual + RMSNorm.
- Accuracy: GSM8K unchanged within run-to-run noise (see below). The fused kernel accumulates in FP32.
- On InferenceX AgentX, GLM-5.3 vs SGLang, with FlashInfer flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6630 to flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6632: decode time on the same turns drops 1.2-3.1% at concurrency 1-8 and 0.4% at 16 on 4x GB200 (1.6-3.1% on 4x B300).

## Validation

- New `tests/kernels/core/test_fused_allreduce_rms_norm.py`: a `MoEOutput` holding an `UnfinalizedMoEOutput`
  through `fused_allreduce_rms_norm` must match finalize, shared add, then `RMSNorm(all_reduce(.))`. It runs on TP
  1, 2 and 4, with 1, 4 and 64 tokens, hidden 2048 and 6144, on both the fused kernel (checking it was called) and
  the fallback. Result on B300 with the FlashInfer fixes: 30 passed, 6 skipped (TP=1 has no fused path).
- End to end on B300 x4 (SM103), GLM-5.2-NVFP4, TP4, MTP 3, `max_model_len` 1M, FP8 KV, on top of the other GLM-5 decode changes
  (#62170, #62171, #62172). "fix only" is FlashInfer with flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6630, "fix + perf" adds
  flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6631.

  Target verify forward, `vllm bench forward` (dummy weights, exact shapes, CUDA graph), us:

  | shape (requests x 4 tokens @ KV) | no deferral | deferral, fix only | deferral, fix + perf |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | 1x4 @25K | 8570.1 | 8618.4 (+0.56%) | 8464.4 (-1.23%) |
  | 3x4 @25K | 12075.2 | 12128.4 (+0.44%) | 11891.7 (-1.52%) |
  | 5x4 @25K | 15470.2 | 15784.6 (+2.03%) | 15357.2 (-0.73%) |
  | 7x4 @25K | 17472.5 | 17849.5 (+2.16%) | 17337.3 (-0.77%) |
  | 1x4 @94K | 8639.5 | 8676.0 (+0.42%) | 8528.0 (-1.29%) |
  | 3x4 @94K | 12267.1 | 12318.9 (+0.42%) | 12081.3 (-1.51%) |
  | 7x4 @94K | 17785.9 | 18160.8 (+2.11%) | 17644.7 (-0.79%) |

  Serving decode ms/token (synthetic acceptance length 3.0, median of 9), batch 1: 3.131 -> 3.094 at 25K and
  3.169 -> 3.131 at 94K (-1.2%) with fix + perf; 3.158 / 3.182 (slower) with fix only.

  nsys node-level trace, batch-1 verify graph per step: `finalizeKernel` (297 us) and most of the
  shared + routed add (elementwise 217 -> 70 us) are gone; finalize + all-reduce + norm 1438 -> 1265 us.

  GSM8K (lm_eval, 5-shot, 1319 questions, real MTP verification, concurrency 32), flexible / strict:

  | | run 1 | run 2 |
  |---|---|---|
  | main | 0.9439 / 0.9424 | 0.9439 / 0.9424 |
  | this PR (with all the changes above) | 0.9401 / 0.9401 | 0.9447 / 0.9424 |

  (stderr 0.0063). Greedy outputs differ from main: the finalize now rounds once instead of after each step.

<details>
<summary>InferenceX AgentX setup and full results (GLM-5.3-NVFP4, vLLM vs SGLang)</summary>

InferenceX c801c9f2d AgentX scenario (pinned AIPerf), 20-minute fast mode, GLM-5.3-NVFP4 rev e3b8f9f2, TP4, MTP 3
(synthetic acceptance 2.99), native KV offload 135 GB per rank, Rust frontend, MoE autotune, `max-num-seqs` =
2 x concurrency. vLLM is main dcd07967ca with its default linear backend and default CUDA graph config, plus the
PRs cumulatively. SGLang a916d91cd3 with IMEX, TRT-LLM all-reduce fusion, `--mem-fraction-static 0.90`. Fresh
server per point, SGLang and the four vLLM variants alternating per concurrency. "Decode" is request latency minus
TTFT, summed over the turns both runs finished (a few hundred per point); fast-mode throughput alone moves about
+-2% between runs.

4x GB200 (c=1/4 on driver 580.173.02; c=8/16 on 580.178.04 after a host reinstall, SGLang rerun there too):

| decode time vs SGLang, same turns | main | + #62170, #62171, #62172 | + #62174 (flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6630, flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6631, flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6632) | + #62173 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| c=1 | +8.9% | +5.8% | +4.0% | +3.2% |
| c=4 | +12.7% | +10.6% | +7.3% | +7.3% |
| c=8 | +12.3% | +9.5% | +7.9% | +7.3% |
| c=16 | -22.6% | -25.0% | -24.5% | -24.3% |

| tok/s/GPU vs SGLang | main | + #62170, #62171, #62172 | + #62174 | + #62173 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| c=1 (SGLang 5,681) | -3.2% | -0.4% | -1.1% | +0.6% |
| c=4 (SGLang 6,783) | -0.6% | -2.4% | +0.4% | -1.7% |
| c=8 (SGLang 11,799) | -11.5% | -9.4% | -8.8% | -8.4% |
| c=16 (SGLang 10,529) | +44.7% | +45.6% | +45.8% | +46.8% |

| decode time vs the previous column, same turns | + #62170, #62171, #62172 | + #62174 | + #62173 |
|---|---|---|---|
| GB200 c=1 / c=4 / c=8 / c=16 | -2.9% / -2.0% / -2.1% / -2.9% | -1.6% / -3.1% / -1.2% / -0.4% | -0.8% / -0.9% / -0.5% / -0.1% |
| B300 c=1 / c=4 | -2.5% / -4.1% | -1.6% / -3.1% | -0.5% / -1.1% |

#62170, #62171 and #62172 were measured together; `vllm bench forward` (target verify forward, spread < 0.1%)
splits their gain about 1/6, 1/2 and 1/3.

</details>

## Details

- `fused_allreduce_rms_norm` accepts a `MoEOutput`. If the routed part is unfinalized, and TP > 1 with the TRT-LLM
  workspace in use, it calls `trtllm_moe_finalize_allreduce_fusion`, which does the top-k sum, routed scaling,
  shared add, all-reduce, residual add and RMSNorm. Called without that kernel available (only possible from
  outside these layers, for example the unit test), it finalizes in torch and takes the normal path.
- `moe_finalize_allreduce_max_num_tokens` bounds deferral by the kernel's one-shot limit (128 tokens) and by the
  size up to which vLLM already picks the one-shot all-reduce. It also creates (or reuses) the shared TRT-LLM
  all-reduce workspace and returns 0 if that fails, so a layer only defers when the fused kernel will run. Above
  the bound, or when the backend isn't `trtllm`, the layer finalizes as before.
- A decoder layer defers only when its experts are TRT-LLM-Gen (NVFP4 or BF16 monolithic/modular, the ones that
  can stop after GEMM2), it isn't sequence parallel, and the router folds `routed_scaling_factor` into the routing
  weights (the deferred output carries no scaling of its own, so the experts' factor must be 1.0). Each
  local layer defers except the last one on a non-last PP rank, since its output leaves as `IntermediateTensors`.
  Layers that feed an aux hidden state (EAGLE-3) don't defer. The MTP block defers into its final norm.
- `_forward_impl` and `_unpack` are used directly, as in `deepseek_v41/nvidia/model.py`, because the runner's
  custom op returns tensors only.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

+def moe_finalize_allreduce_max_num_tokens(hidden_size: int, dtype: torch.dtype) -> int:
+    """Most tokens a deferred MoE output can be finalized for by one fused
+    finalize + all-reduce + RMSNorm kernel, or 0 if that kernel is unavailable.
+
+    FlashInfer's MoE-finalize all-reduce is one-shot only and runs on the
+    TRT-LLM workspace, so this stays within both its own one-shot bound and the
+    size up to which vLLM picks the one-shot all-reduce anyway. Used by a MoE
+    layer to decide whether, and up to which batch size, to leave its top-k
+    reduction to ``fused_allreduce_rms_norm``.
+    """
+    tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+    if tp_size == 1 or flashinfer_trtllm_fused_allreduce_norm is None:
+        return 0
+    from vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.allreduce_rms_fusion import (
+        _FI_ALLREDUCE_ONE_SHOT_MAX_SIZES_MB,
+    )
+    from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.flashinfer_all_reduce import (
+        _resolve_fi_ar_backend,
+    )
+
+    backend, _ = _resolve_fi_ar_backend(get_tp_group().cpu_group)
+    capability = current_platform.get_device_capability()
+    if backend != "trtllm" or capability is None:
+        return 0
+    one_shot_mb = _FI_ALLREDUCE_ONE_SHOT_MAX_SIZES_MB.get(capability.to_int(), {}).get(
+        tp_size
+    )
+    max_token_num = _max_token_num(tp_size, hidden_size, dtype)
+    if one_shot_mb is None or max_token_num is None:
+        return 0
+    element_size = torch.tensor([], dtype=dtype).element_size()
+    return min(
+        _MOE_FINALIZE_ONE_SHOT_MAX_TOKENS,
+        int(one_shot_mb * MiB) // (hidden_size * element_size),
+        max_token_num,
+    )
+
+
+def _moe_finalize_allreduce_rms_norm(
+    moe_output: MoEOutput,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    norm: RMSNorm,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    routed = moe_output.routed
+    if not isinstance(routed, UnfinalizedMoEOutput):
+        return fused_allreduce_rms_norm(
+            _add_shared_output(routed, moe_output), residual, norm
+        )
+
+    # The fused kernel reads the routing weights in the activation dtype.
+    expert_weights = routed.expert_weights.to(residual.dtype)
+    tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+    if tp_size > 1 and flashinfer_trtllm_fused_allreduce_norm is not None:
+        from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.flashinfer_all_reduce import (
+            flashinfer_comm,
+            get_fi_ar_workspace,
+        )
+
+        # The kernel sizes its all-reduce by the token output, i.e. residual.
+        ok, max_token_num = _can_use_flashinfer(residual, tp_size)
+        workspace = (
+            get_fi_ar_workspace(
+                world_size=tp_size,
+                rank=get_tensor_model_parallel_rank(),
+                max_token_num=max_token_num,
+                hidden_dim=residual.shape[-1],
+                dtype=residual.dtype,
+                group=get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+            )
+            if ok
+            else None
+        )
+        if workspace is not None and workspace.backend == "trtllm":
+            norm_out = torch.empty_like(residual)
+            residual_out = torch.empty_like(residual)
+            flashinfer_comm.trtllm_moe_finalize_allreduce_fusion(
+                allreduce_in=routed.gemm2_permuted,
+                residual_in=residual,
+                norm_weight=norm.weight,
+                expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=routed.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx,
+                norm_out=norm_out,
+                residual_out=residual_out,
+                quant_out=None,
+                scale_out=None,
+                workspace_ptrs=workspace.workspace_tensor,
+                launch_with_pdl=True,
+                world_rank=workspace.rank,
+                world_size=workspace.world_size,
+                eps=norm.variance_epsilon,
+                shared_expert_output=moe_output.shared_output,
+                expert_scale_factor=expert_weights,
+                routed_scaling_factor=moe_output.routed_scaling_factor,
+            )
+            return norm_out, residual_out
+
+    # Finalize the top-k reduction unfused, then reduce as a plain partial.
+    permuted_idx = routed.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx

@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Tests ``fused_allreduce_rms_norm`` on a MoE output whose top-k reduction is
+still open (``MoEOutput`` holding an ``UnfinalizedMoEOutput``).
+
+It must match the unfused path: finalize the routed output, add the shared
+expert output, then ``RMSNorm(all_reduce(.), residual)``. Covers the FlashInfer
+MoE-finalize all-reduce kernel (TP>1) and the eager fallback.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch.multiprocessing import spawn
+
+from tests.utils import ensure_current_vllm_config, init_test_distributed_environment
+from vllm.distributed import cleanup_dist_env_and_memory
+from vllm.distributed.communication_op import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import (
+    MoEOutput,
+    UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.models.common.ops import fused_allreduce_rms_norm as fused_ar_norm
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_random_seed
+
+TOP_K = 8
+
+
+@ensure_current_vllm_config()
+def _worker_moe_finalize_ar_norm(
+    local_rank, world_size, port, num_tokens, hidden_size, fused, seed
+):
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{local_rank}")
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+    init_test_distributed_environment(
+        world_size, 1, local_rank, port, local_rank=local_rank
+    )
+    if fused:
+        import flashinfer.comm as flashinfer_comm
+
+        kernel = flashinfer_comm.trtllm_moe_finalize_allreduce_fusion
+        calls = []
+
+        def counted_kernel(**kwargs):
+            calls.append(kwargs)
+            kernel(**kwargs)
+
+        flashinfer_comm.trtllm_moe_finalize_allreduce_fusion = counted_kernel
+    else:
+        fused_ar_norm.flashinfer_trtllm_fused_allreduce_norm = None
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+
+    set_random_seed(seed)
+    norm = RMSNorm(hidden_size, eps=1e-5).cuda().to(dtype)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        norm.weight.normal_(mean=1.0, std=0.1)
+    residual = 4 * torch.randn(num_tokens, hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+
+    # Per-rank partial MoE outputs: GEMM2 rows are permuted into a padded
+    # buffer, and the permute map sends each (token, k) to a distinct row.
+    torch.manual_seed(seed + 1000 + local_rank)
+    num_rows = 2 * num_tokens * TOP_K + 16
+    gemm2 = torch.randn(num_rows, hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+    permuted_idx = (
+        torch.randperm(num_rows, device=device)[: num_tokens * TOP_K]
+        .to(torch.int32)
+        .view(num_tokens, TOP_K)
+    )
+    weights = torch.rand(num_tokens, TOP_K, device=device).to(dtype)
+    shared = torch.randn(num_tokens, hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+
+    # Reference: the unfused path (FP32 top-k sum, shared add, AR, RMSNorm).
+    routed = (gemm2[permuted_idx.long()].float() * weights.float()[..., None]).sum(1)
+    partial = shared + routed.to(dtype)
+    ref_out, ref_res = norm(tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(partial), residual.clone())
+
+    moe_output = MoEOutput(
+        routed=UnfinalizedMoEOutput(
+            gemm2_permuted=gemm2,
+            expert_weights=weights,
+            expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=permuted_idx,
+        ),
+        shared_output=shared,
+    )
+    out, res = fused_ar_norm.fused_allreduce_rms_norm(
+        moe_output, residual.clone(), norm
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    if fused:
+        assert len(calls) == 1
+
+    # The fused kernel sums the top-k and the ranks in BF16.
+    torch.testing.assert_close(res, ref_res, atol=0.25, rtol=2e-2)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref_out, atol=6e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+    cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="CUDA required")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("world_size", [1, 2, 4])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [1, 4, 64])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hidden_size", [2048, 6144])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fused", [True, False])
+def test_fused_allreduce_rms_norm_moe_output(
+    world_size, num_tokens, hidden_size, fused
+):
+    if world_size == 1 and fused:
+        pytest.skip("TP==1 has no fused path")
+    if current_platform.device_count() < world_size:
+        pytest.skip(f"Need >= {world_size} GPUs")
+    spawn(
+        _worker_moe_finalize_ar_norm,
+        args=(world_size, str(get_open_port()), num_tokens, hidden_size, fused, 0),
+        nprocs=world_size,
+        join=True,
+    )

 This recovers a fusion that vLLM's torch.compile passes would normally do but
 that doesn't fire for models running eager (or under a breakable CUDA graph).
+A MoE output whose top-k reduction is still open (an ``UnfinalizedMoEOutput``)
+has that reduction and the shared-expert add folded into the same kernel.

+    get_tensor_model_parallel_rank,

+    get_tp_group,

     _AR_RESIDUAL_RMS_NORM,
+    MiB,
     _can_use_flashinfer,
+    _max_token_num,
     flashinfer_trtllm_fused_allreduce_norm,
 )
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import (
+    MoEOutput,
+    UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+)
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform

+# FlashInfer's MoE-finalize all-reduce is one-shot only and warns past this many
+# tokens (kOneShotMaxToken in trtllm_moe_allreduce_fusion.cuh).

 def fused_allreduce_rms_norm(
-    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor | MoEOutput,
     residual: torch.Tensor,
     norm: RMSNorm,
 ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
     """All-reduce + add residual + (standard) RMSNorm, fused via flashinfer.
 
     ``hidden_states`` is the per-rank *partial* output of a row-parallel linear
-    run with ``reduce_results=False``; ``norm`` is the RMSNorm applied right
-    after. Returns ``(normed_output, new_residual)``, equivalent to
+    run with ``reduce_results=False``, or of a MoE layer whose reduction was
+    left open (``MoEOutput``); ``norm`` is the RMSNorm applied right after.
+    Returns ``(normed_output, new_residual)``, equivalent to
     ``norm(all_reduce(hidden_states), residual)``. Falls back to an explicit

     """

+        return _moe_finalize_allreduce_rms_norm(hidden_states, residual, norm)

@@ -61,3 +80,131 @@ def fused_allreduce_rms_norm(
 
     reduced = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(hidden_states)
     return norm(reduced, residual)
+
+
+def moe_finalize_allreduce_max_num_tokens(hidden_size: int, dtype: torch.dtype) -> int:
+    """Most tokens a deferred MoE output can be finalized for by one fused
+    finalize + all-reduce + RMSNorm kernel, or 0 if that kernel is unavailable.
+
+    FlashInfer's MoE-finalize all-reduce is one-shot only and runs on the
+    TRT-LLM workspace, so this stays within both its own one-shot bound and the
+    size up to which vLLM picks the one-shot all-reduce anyway. Used by a MoE
+    layer to decide whether, and up to which batch size, to leave its top-k
+    reduction to ``fused_allreduce_rms_norm``. Creates (or reuses) that
+    workspace, so a layer only defers when the fused kernel will run.
+    """
+    tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+    if tp_size == 1 or flashinfer_trtllm_fused_allreduce_norm is None:
+        return 0
+    from vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.allreduce_rms_fusion import (
+        _FI_ALLREDUCE_ONE_SHOT_MAX_SIZES_MB,
+    )
+    from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.flashinfer_all_reduce import (
+        _resolve_fi_ar_backend,
+        get_fi_ar_workspace,
+    )
+
+    backend, _ = _resolve_fi_ar_backend(get_tp_group().cpu_group)
+    capability = current_platform.get_device_capability()
+    if backend != "trtllm" or capability is None:
+        return 0
+    one_shot_mb = _FI_ALLREDUCE_ONE_SHOT_MAX_SIZES_MB.get(capability.to_int(), {}).get(
+        tp_size
+    )
+    max_token_num = _max_token_num(tp_size, hidden_size, dtype)
+    if one_shot_mb is None or max_token_num is None:
+        return 0
+    workspace = get_fi_ar_workspace(
+        world_size=tp_size,
+        rank=get_tensor_model_parallel_rank(),
+        max_token_num=max_token_num,
+        hidden_dim=hidden_size,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        group=get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+    )
+    if workspace is None or workspace.backend != "trtllm":
+        return 0
+    element_size = torch.tensor([], dtype=dtype).element_size()
+    return min(
+        _MOE_FINALIZE_ONE_SHOT_MAX_TOKENS,
+        int(one_shot_mb * MiB) // (hidden_size * element_size),
+        max_token_num,
+    )
+
+
+def _moe_finalize_allreduce_rms_norm(
+    moe_output: MoEOutput,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    norm: RMSNorm,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    routed = moe_output.routed
+    if not isinstance(routed, UnfinalizedMoEOutput):
+        return fused_allreduce_rms_norm(
+            _add_shared_output(routed, moe_output), residual, norm
+        )
+
+    # The fused kernel reads the routing weights in the activation dtype.
+    expert_weights = routed.expert_weights.to(residual.dtype)
+    tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+    if tp_size > 1 and flashinfer_trtllm_fused_allreduce_norm is not None:
+        from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.flashinfer_all_reduce import (
+            flashinfer_comm,
+            get_fi_ar_workspace,
+        )
+
+        # The kernel sizes its all-reduce by the token output, i.e. residual.
+        ok, max_token_num = _can_use_flashinfer(residual, tp_size)
+        workspace = (
+            get_fi_ar_workspace(
+                world_size=tp_size,
+                rank=get_tensor_model_parallel_rank(),
+                max_token_num=max_token_num,
+                hidden_dim=residual.shape[-1],
+                dtype=residual.dtype,
+                group=get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+            )
+            if ok
+            else None
+        )
+        if workspace is not None and workspace.backend == "trtllm":
+            norm_out = torch.empty_like(residual)
+            residual_out = torch.empty_like(residual)
+            flashinfer_comm.trtllm_moe_finalize_allreduce_fusion(
+                allreduce_in=routed.gemm2_permuted,
+                residual_in=residual,
+                norm_weight=norm.weight,
+                expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=routed.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx,
+                norm_out=norm_out,
+                residual_out=residual_out,
+                quant_out=None,
+                scale_out=None,
+                workspace_ptrs=workspace.workspace_tensor,
+                launch_with_pdl=True,
+                world_rank=workspace.rank,
+                world_size=workspace.world_size,
+                eps=norm.variance_epsilon,
+                shared_expert_output=moe_output.shared_output,
+                expert_scale_factor=expert_weights,
+                routed_scaling_factor=moe_output.routed_scaling_factor,
+            )
+            return norm_out, residual_out
+
+    # Layers defer only when the fused kernel is available (see
+    # moe_finalize_allreduce_max_num_tokens); other callers finalize unfused here.
+    permuted_idx = routed.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx
+    rows = routed.gemm2_permuted[permuted_idx.clamp(min=0).long()]
+    weights = torch.where(permuted_idx >= 0, expert_weights.float(), 0.0)
+    routed_output = (rows.float() * weights.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1)
+    return fused_allreduce_rms_norm(
+        _add_shared_output(routed_output.to(residual.dtype), moe_output),
+        residual,
+        norm,
+    )
+
+
+def _add_shared_output(routed: torch.Tensor, moe_output: MoEOutput) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if moe_output.routed_scaling_factor != 1.0:
+        routed = routed * moe_output.routed_scaling_factor
+    if moe_output.shared_output is None:
+        return routed
+    return moe_output.shared_output + routed

+        ok, max_token_num = _can_use_flashinfer(residual, tp_size)
+        workspace = (
+            get_fi_ar_workspace(
+                world_size=tp_size,
+                rank=get_tensor_model_parallel_rank(),
+                max_token_num=max_token_num,
+                hidden_dim=residual.shape[-1],
+                dtype=residual.dtype,
+                group=get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+            )
+            if ok
+            else None
+        )
+        if workspace is not None and workspace.backend == "trtllm":
+            norm_out = torch.empty_like(residual)
+            residual_out = torch.empty_like(residual)
+            flashinfer_comm.trtllm_moe_finalize_allreduce_fusion(
+                allreduce_in=routed.gemm2_permuted,
+                residual_in=residual,
+                norm_weight=norm.weight,
+                expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=routed.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx,
+                norm_out=norm_out,
+                residual_out=residual_out,
+                quant_out=None,
+                scale_out=None,
+                workspace_ptrs=workspace.workspace_tensor,
+                launch_with_pdl=True,
+                world_rank=workspace.rank,
+                world_size=workspace.world_size,
+                eps=norm.variance_epsilon,
+                shared_expert_output=moe_output.shared_output,
+                expert_scale_factor=expert_weights,
+                routed_scaling_factor=moe_output.routed_scaling_factor,
+            )
+            return norm_out, residual_out
+
+    # Finalize the top-k reduction unfused, then reduce as a plain partial.
+    permuted_idx = routed.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx
